issues.detail: The skill assumes Node.js, pnpm, and specific OS utilities, limiting cross-platform compatibility.

scenarios.name: open-dashboard-current-repo
scenarios.rationale: Response B covers node count, URL, and kill command (though not exact) and is more complete than A, which provides none of the required details.

scenarios.name: remote-dashboard-port-forward
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies the rubric, while Response B omits key details such as launching the viewer with a different port, confirming 127.0.0.1 binding, and providing the token URL.

scenarios.name: stale-token-bookmark
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers the required grep extraction, stable token setting, and URL token inclusion, but omits the address‑bar removal detail; Response B is unrelated to the viewer log and token handling described in the rubric.
